subject: Trial kickoff — next steps & quick checklist
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Trial kickoff — next steps & quick checklist

Hey Liam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before your trial environment goes live: 

1) What we’ll provide (by EOD Monday): a dedicated trial instance pinned to rwd-mistral-7b, an initial token allotment for 2k requests/day, and a short Runbook for onboarding. (Connor will provision infra.)
2) Your action items: share 1–2 representative prompt sets and a sample dataset for the inference privacy tests; confirm SMTP/SSO requirements if you want audit logs forwarded to your SIEM.
3) Timing: we recommended a 2-week sandbox and a 1-week evaluation period. If you want to shorten or adjust, say so and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded a draft POC scope and a sample SLA — attaching filenames below. We’ll finalize once you confirm the data flow and SSO requirements.

Next meeting: propose Wed 5/6 10am PST to review any blockers and validate test prompts — does that work?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: POC_Scope_Skysurge_v1.pdf, SLA-draft.docx
From: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — next steps & quick checklist

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear summary. Wed 5/6 10am PST works for Aisha and me. I’ll pull the prompt sets together and loop in procurement if any contract changes are needed.

One heads-up: procurement will likely request info on data residency and SSO before we provision anything production-adjacent. Can you share the short answers for those (quick bullet points)?

—Liam
Liam Parker
Head of Product, Skysurge AI
liam.parker@skysurge.ai
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — next steps & quick checklist

Perfect — appreciate the heads-up. Quick bullets below you can share with procurement: 

- Data residency: trial instances are provisioned in us-west-2 by default for your account; we can pin to a specific region if required.
- SSO: we support SAML and OIDC; Connor will share the integration checklist.
- Audit logs: available via syslog/HTTP forward to your SIEM; retention policies configurable per trial.

I’ve re-attached the POC scope and the sample SLA in case procurement wants to see those now. Connor, can you standby to provision once Liam confirms the prompt set?

Thanks,
Dylan

Attachments: POC_Scope_Skysurge_v1.pdf, SLA-draft.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in — trial setup & Wed 5/6 sync missed

Hey Liam — checking in since we missed the Wed session and I haven’t seen the prompt sets yet. Wanted to make sure nothing landed on your plate unexpectedly. 

If priorities changed, no problem — just a quick reply with timing (this week/next week/hold) so we can align resources. If procurement needs anything specific from our side to move forward, tell me and I’ll escalate.

Short items to unblock: 
- Confirm prompt sets (one ZIP or GDrive link)
- Confirm whether you want SAML or OIDC for SSO (we’ll send metadata)

Thanks for any quick update.

—Dylan
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Checking in — trial setup & Wed 5/6 sync missed

Hi Liam — Evelyn here (Head of Sales Operations at Redwood). Dylan mentioned the trial kickoff has stalled. We value Skysurge as a strategic evaluation and want to make sure procurement hurdles don’t slow you down. 

If it helps, I can: 
- Fast-track a one-page compliance summary for procurement;
- Schedule a 30-min call between our security lead and your procurement to answer SSO/audit questions live; or
- Temporarily extend the token allotment and pause billing/constraints until the audit is complete.

Let me know what would be most helpful and we’ll make it happen quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Bhatia <aisha.bhatia@skysurge.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Parker <liam.parker@skysurge.ai>, procurement@skysurge.ai
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — next steps & quick checklist

Hi all — apologies for the delay; procurement did pick up the request and we ran into a blocker around audit evidence and SSO metadata. Two quick notes: 

1) Procurement asked to see a single-page evidence summary (SOC2 status, log forwarding options, where logs are stored/retained) and confirmation that trial data will not be used for model training.
2) We’re also mid-quarter and product resources are overloaded; we’d like to pause the hands-on trial for now and revisit in ~3 weeks.

If you can provide the one-pager and confirm the training/data policy, we’ll keep the conversation warm and rebook the onboarding after the quarter calms down. Really appreciate the patience.

Thanks,
Aisha Bhatia
Product Manager, Skysurge AI

Attachments referenced: procurement_request_5-10.pdf (received), but we don’t need you to upload it — it’s internal.
